reason: Last month I lost an order only because the other fellow quoted first, so a quote ready on my WhatsApp in minutes hits exactly where it hurts. Rs 5,000 with money back if it doesn't work is small enough that my CA will say try it, but I am only buying the pilot, not the 60,000 yet.
objection: IndiaMART already gives me enquiries and a catalogue, and my rates change daily and depend on the party. I doubt a machine will get 7 out of 10 prices right without me fixing them, and after the pilot 60,000 plus 5,000 every month is real money for a 4-person firm.
would_change_my_mind: If in the pilot it quotes my real enquiries correctly and I actually win orders I would have lost, then I will pay the setup. If the quotes need my correction every time, I stop after 14 days.
